parameters.content:
## 1. Research & Ideation (weekly)
Collect trend/competitor signals, run the Trend Scout agent, score every idea, and route pass/maybe/reject.

See agents/01-trend-scout.md and agents/02-idea-scorer.md.

## 2. Idea Scoring
Each idea gets qualitative sub-scores from Claude (Idea Scorer agent), then a deterministic weighted total from scoring/rubric.json — same logic as scoring/score_idea.js.

nodes.name: Idea Rejected or Maybe — Stop
nodes.notes: Routed to ideas/scored or ideas/rejected by the previous node. Nothing further happens automatically — the Trend Scout will not resurface it (checks ideas/rejected/).

parameters.content:
## 3. Research -> Draft -> Fact-Check -> Language Edit
Only ideas with verdict=pass reach here. A FAIL fact-check or a re-score recommendation stops the pipeline for human triage.

nodes.name: Weak Topic — Notify Human
nodes.notes: Research Agent flagged RECOMMEND RE-SCORE. A human should re-evaluate before any further automated work is spent on this idea.

nodes.name: Script Failed Fact-Check — Notify Human
nodes.notes: Fact Checker verdict was FAIL on a load-bearing claim. Revise via Story Writer manually or re-run after fixing the research dossier.

parameters.content:
## 4. Human Sign-off -> Title/Thumbnail -> Storyboard
Final script sign-off is a mandatory human gate (editorial-rules.md §9) before any rendering cost is spent.

nodes.name: Human Script Approval Gate
nodes.notes: MVP human gate. Configure a form/webhook resume in n8n UI per editorial-rules.md §9 (final script sign-off is never automated).

parameters.content:
## 5. Voiceover -> Remotion Render -> QA -> Private Upload
Requires: ElevenLabs API key, a rendering machine with Remotion + ffmpeg/ffprobe installed, and a verified YouTube Data API OAuth app. See docs/SETUP.md.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.narration, model_id: 'eleven_multilingual_v2', voice_settings: { stability: 0.5, similarity_boost: 0.75 } }) }}

nodes.name: Render QA Failed — Notify Human
nodes.notes: Rendered video duration is outside the 8-16 minute expected range, or ffprobe failed. Check the render manually before uploading.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: 'New Invisible Why video uploaded privately and ready for title/thumbnail/publish review: https://studio.youtube.com/video/' + $json.id + '/edit' }) }}
